record.question: Max Weber says that ideal types:
options: Are derived from the real world but they are merely mental constructs that have been exaggerated.
Are found abundantly in ancient and primitive societies but largely forgotten today.
Are idealistic and are therefore necessary in the difficult task of making society more moralistic.
Are the necessary philosophical ideas that help categorise the various schools of thought in the discipline of Sociology.
